Ex-husband of woman accused in child deaths threatens legal action

Patrick Clancy, the ex-husband of Lindsay Clancy, has threatened legal action against individuals spreading conspiracy theories about the deaths of their three children. His lawyer stated that there will be consequences for those engaging in "relentless" conspiracy theories. The legal threat comes amid ongoing public discussion and speculation surrounding the case.
